title: András Bay to Ferenc Rákóczi II, Jászvásár 8 March 1706 (DECODE R478)

documents.shelfmark: MNL OL G15 Caps. D. Fasc. 81. 5 (DECODE R478)

plaintext.source: No prior plaintext; read here with Rakoczi's key DECODE R609.

transcription.notes: DECODE transcription (AJ 2020) corrected against the images: 7 fixes. Group count from decode.py's parse (digits are spaced, so --measure cannot split them).

system.summary: Hungarian two-digit syllabary (letters with homophones, CV syllables, short words) plus a 149-293 nomenclator of places, peoples and titles, with nulls.
system.sibling_key: DECODE R609 (G15 C 43/56); R561 an earlier issue
system.notes: Key not linked to the letter on DECODE.

prior_solution.where: DECODE 'Non-decrypted'; web search found no edition

conditions.human_role: Posed the target; supplied the DECODE session cookie earlier.

solution.what: Fetched R478 record, DECODE transcription and both page images with the project cookie.
Fetched the 94 G15 key transcriptions (R549-R646) and scored each on R478 by coverage and Hungarian 4-gram score (score_keys.py).
R609 ranked first (98% coverage, -2.57/char) and gave running Hungarian; R561 second.
Checked DECODE's transcription line by line against the images; 7 corrections (iv->10, 0->clear é, 1257->127, 74 and 63 restored, etc.).
decode.py: 414 groups, 413 with R609 values, 50 = ba from context; one ~10-group stretch reads letter by letter without clear sense.
Web search (Hungarian) for Bay's 1706 Moldavian despatches: no edition or decipherment found.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: DECODE never linked a key to R478; decrypting it with each of the 94 G15 key transcriptions (score_keys.py, Hungarian 4-gram) picked Rakoczi's syllabic key R609, which then read the letter unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decode.py over R478_transcription.txt: 414 cipher groups all given values; ~10 groups in one p. 2 stretch read letter by letter but not as sense, counted unread (404/414).
outcome.notes: Report from the Moldavian court: Muscovite and Polish envoys, Tsar seeking peace with Charles XII, Pekri's message to the voivode, the Swede at Vilna.
